opening.argument: The clearest substance is a retrospective trading lesson, not a promise of a predictable result. The video explains which indicators to use and which mistakes to avoid when taking similar trades, while also stating that the described position carried $500 in risk. It expressly acknowledges uncertainty: “you never know how far price can move,” and concedes that “sometimes open interest doesn't give you accuracy.” The account also includes an unsuccessful trade, which further presents trading as variable rather than assured. A separate description promotes a partner exchange and advertises up to $30,050+ in welcome rewards, but the supplied material does not connect that offer to deceptive conditions or outcomes. The related material is also described as free through a description link.
